Name: Stamina and Health training
Author: Somerandomguy135
Description:
This increases your energy and your health by doing activities which use up energy or by getting damaged by enemies.
One point of energy/health used/lost equals to one xp point and if you have enough xp you level up, which will increase your energy/health.
Other than an increase of energy and health you will also receive boosts.
An increase in stamina will also give you a speed boost, while an increase in health will give an attack boost and a defence boost.

In the config file you can adjust the values of when a limit is reached for the training, how strong the boosts should be and more.


This is my first ever created mod and was also my first time using c# to code. I coincidentally saw the Stardew Valley Modfest and wanted to participate in the event. Since this is my first mod ever I would be happy to receive any feedback.
